_playerViews.question: do the back and side read as the SAME CHARACTER as the approved front?
_playerViews.methodChosen: DERIVATION at 32x48 — img2img was tried first and lost on evidence
_playerViews.img2imgVerdict: 14 generations across denoise {0.30 0.40 0.50 0.65 0.80 0.86 0.92} x {back, side}. No denoise value both turns the view and holds identity: <=0.80 returns the front unchanged, 0.86 is still front-facing yet already drifting, 0.92 turns the view and destroys the identity (star on the BACK of the cap, a different face, a different bag). Identity drift starts BEFORE view rotation does, so there is no window.
_playerViews.guardrail: G13 caps this task at 20 generations; 14 were spent, all img2img, all recorded above.
